macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stock futures rebound as oil retreats after renewed Iran tensions
items.summary: U.S. stock index futures edged higher after oil prices steadied, with investors weighing renewed geopolitical anxiety from fresh U.S. strikes on Iran. Reuters said the move followed sharp losses earlier in the week when Nasdaq futures hit a four-week low.

items.title: Wall Street futures stabilize after sharp selloff driven by Middle East conflict
items.summary: Reuters reported that U.S. stock index futures rebounded as oil prices fell back, easing some pressure on risk assets after the latest escalation involving Iran. The market reaction reflected concern that higher energy prices could weigh on growth and inflation.

items.title: Fed’s John Williams says he does not expect a sustained energy-price spike
items.summary: New York Fed President John Williams said he was not expecting the Middle East conflict to cause a lasting surge in energy prices through the rest of the year. His remarks were among the main Federal Reserve developments cited in Reuters markets coverage.

items.title: ECB minutes show inflation seen staying above target into next year
items.summary: European Central Bank accounts released Thursday showed policymakers were presented with projections indicating inflation would remain above target into next year despite nearly three rate cuts. The minutes reinforced the ECB’s cautious stance on further easing.

items.title: Japan’s 10-year government bond yield hits 30-year high
items.summary: Reuters reported that Japan’s benchmark 10-year JGB yield rose to a 30-year high amid renewed inflation worries and concern over fiscal health. The move highlighted pressure on global bond markets as oil prices rose.

items.title: Pound rises to four-week highs as dollar eases
items.summary: Sterling climbed to around its highest level in four weeks as the dollar backed off prior highs and oil prices retreated modestly. Reuters said volatility picked up in currency markets as traders reacted to Middle East developments.

items.title: U.S. markets and tech stocks face pressure from leverage and funding strains
items.summary: Reuters reported that U.S. equity funding markets remain stretched after last month’s spike in short-term borrowing costs, with near-record stock prices and enthusiasm for technology shares increasing leverage demand. The note pointed to fragility beneath the broader rally.

items.title: Big market moves: S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 under pressure in recent sessions
items.summary: MarketScreener’s 24-hour market list showed the S&P 500 down 1.44% and the Nasdaq 100 down 3.29%, reflecting a weak tone for U.S. equities. It also flagged sharp losses in several cyclicals and industrial names, including Rheinmetall and Hyundai Motor.

items.title: SK Hynix share offering draws strong demand
items.summary: Reuters reported that demand for SK Hynix’s U.S. share offering was more than seven times the shares available, indicating robust investor appetite for the memory-chip maker. The deal was one of the notable company-specific developments in the latest coverage.

items.title: U.S. economic data: jobless claims fall, existing home sales unexpectedly drop
items.summary: Reuters said weekly jobless claims fell, suggesting labor market conditions remain stable, while existing home sales unexpectedly declined in June as high prices and elevated mortgage rates kept buyers on the sidelines. Together, the data reinforced a picture of slower but still resilient U.S. growth.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds toward $64K after exploit fallout and Strategy sales fade
items.summary: Bitcoin rose 1.6% in the last 24 hours to around $63,692, after reaching as high as $64,160, its highest level since July 31. The move followed selling pressure tied to a Coldcard wallet exploit and Strategy’s recent Bitcoin sales, while market sentiment remained in 'extreme fear' and ETF flows were mixed.

items.title: US crypto regulation fight intensifies ahead of CLARITY vote
items.summary: Cointelegraph and crypto.news reported heightened political pressure around the CLARITY Act, including moves involving Coinbase’s legal leadership and White House pushback over SEC-related claims. The broader regulatory backdrop also includes Senate debate over developer protections in the crypto bill.

items.title: European regulators consider expanding MiCA to cover tokenization and non-EU stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The Block reported that the European Commission is looking to broaden MiCA oversight to include tokenization and stablecoin issuers based outside the EU. That would extend one of the world’s most important crypto rulebooks into additional parts of the digital-asset market.

items.title: Hong Kong tightens crypto platform security rules with SMS authentication changes
items.summary: crypto.news reported that Hong Kong’s SFC is forcing crypto platforms to drop SMS authentication, signaling a continued regulatory focus on exchange and custody security. The move adds to a wave of compliance changes across major jurisdictions.

items.title: BNB Chain starts work on new Layer 1 for agentic trading
items.summary: The Block reported that BNB Chain is building a new Layer 1 aimed at agentic trading, with a target mainnet launch in 2027. The project is part of a broader push into infrastructure for autonomous onchain execution.

items.title: Binance Wallet adds Plume yield vault access to funds from Invesco and Bitwise
items.summary: The Block reported that Binance Wallet now supports Plume’s yield vault offering, expanding user access to products tied to Invesco and Bitwise funds. The move highlights continued growth in tokenized and onchain structured products.

items.title: Cardano governance shifts after wallet exploit
items.summary: The Block reported that EMURGO stepped down from its Pentad governance role following a wallet exploit. The development adds governance and security pressure to the Cardano ecosystem.

items.title: XRP gains attention as SWIFT-linked banking payments move into focus
items.summary: crypto.news reported that XRP rose after SWIFT tapped Ripple-linked banks for blockchain payments. The report adds to ongoing interest in enterprise payment use cases for Ripple-connected infrastructure.
